query:
SELECT r.id AS "repository_id: Uuid",
                  r.name AS repository_name,
                  u.user_name AS owner_name,
                  (r.user_id = $3 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                             FROM repository_users ru
                                             WHERE ru.repository_id = r.id AND ru.user_id = $3)) AS "readable!: bool",
                  d.path,
                  d.blob_oid,
                  e.status       AS "status?: DocumentExtractionStatus",
                  e.ocr          AS "ocr?",
                  e.error        AS "error?",
                  e.extractor    AS "extractor?",
                  e.extracted_at AS "extracted_at?: DateTime<Utc>"
           FROM repository_documents d
                    JOIN repositories r ON r.id = d.repository_id
                    JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id
                    LEFT JOIN document_extractions e ON e.blob_oid = d.blob_oid
           WHERE CASE $2
                     WHEN 'CONVERTED' THEN e.extractor IN (SELECT value FROM json_each($1))
                                               AND e.status = 'COMPLETED'
                     WHEN 'FAILED' THEN e.extractor IN (SELECT value FROM json_each($1))
                                            AND e.status = 'FAILED'
                     WHEN 'PENDING' THEN e.extractor IS NULL
                                             OR e.extractor NOT IN (SELECT value FROM json_each($1))
                     ELSE TRUE
                     END
           ORDER BY r.name, r.id, d.path
           LIMIT $5 OFFSET $4
